novel_features.name: Snapshot Diff
novel_features.description: Compare two canvas snapshots and see exactly which elements were added, removed, or moved.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local SQLite snapshot history — no existing tool tracks element-level deltas between named saves.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when you need to audit diagram changes, review what an AI agent drew, or verify a refactoring didn't break diagram structure.

novel_features.name: One-step Mermaid to PNG
novel_features.description: Convert a Mermaid diagram file to a PNG or SVG in one command — no separate steps needed.
novel_features.rationale: Wraps three API calls (from-mermaid + snapshot + export-image) transparently in a single invocation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use in CI/CD pipelines to turn Mermaid specs into diagram images without manual canvas interaction.

novel_features.name: Canvas Stats
novel_features.description: See element type distribution, color palette in use, and bounding box summary for the current canvas.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates across element types and properties — only possible via local store or live API scan.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to understand canvas composition before asking an AI to modify or extend a diagram.

novel_features.name: Stale Diagram Check
novel_features.description: Walk a directory for .excalidraw files and flag diagrams that haven't been updated in N days.
novel_features.rationale: Correlates .excalidraw file modification dates with a configurable threshold; no other tool does this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use in CI to catch documentation diagrams that may be out of date with the codebase they describe.

novel_features.name: Agent Context Dump
novel_features.description: Emit a compact canvas summary (element count, type histogram, bounding box) sized for agent context windows.
novel_features.rationale: Optimized for agent consumption: --compact strips verbose fields, --select allows field narrowing.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use at the start of any agent task that involves the canvas so the agent knows current state without reading all elements.

narrative.headline: The only Go CLI for Excalidraw — control your canvas, convert Mermaid, diff snapshots, and manage cloud scenes from one binary.
narrative.value_prop: excalidraw-mcp-pp-cli drives the Excalidraw canvas server REST API and Excalidraw Plus cloud in one Go binary. Every command supports --json and --agent for scripting and AI pipelines. Snapshot versioning, one-step Mermaid→PNG conversion, and diagram stale-checks are built in.
narrative.auth_narrative: Canvas commands (elements, snapshots, viewport, convert) need no auth — they talk to the local canvas server at http://127.0.0.1:3000. Cloud commands (scenes, collections, workspace) require EXCALIDRAW_API_KEY from your Excalidraw Plus workspace settings.

quickstart.comment: Verify canvas server is reachable and (optionally) cloud API key is valid
See all elements currently on the canvas
Add a labelled box to the canvas
Convert a Mermaid diagram to PNG in one step
Save the current canvas state before making changes
Compare two snapshots to see what changed

troubleshoots.fix: Start the canvas server: docker run -p 3000:3000 ghcr.io/yctimlin/mcp_excalidraw-canvas:latest
The Excalidraw browser tab must be open at http://127.0.0.1:3000 for PNG/SVG export
Set export EXCALIDRAW_API_KEY=<key> — get your key from plus.excalidraw.com workspace settings
Check that the canvas server version supports from-mermaid (v0.7.0+); restart with latest Docker image

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent needs to create, inspect, or export Excalidraw diagrams programmatically. It excels at CI/CD diagram generation, converting Mermaid specs to PNG, auditing canvas state before an AI makes changes, and syncing local diagrams to Excalidraw Plus cloud.
